tables.title: DCMIPP_P1STyCR (y = 1, 2, 3), DCMIPP_P1STySR (y = 1, 2, 3),
tables.text: Table 351, "DCMIPP_P1STyCR (y = 1, 2, 3), DCMIPP_P1STySR (y = 1, 2, 3),", in section 39.6.11 (Statistics extraction) on page 1858. Columns: Bit ID, Value, Comments, . 14 data row(s).

rows:
–1: Active
–0: Bypasses R, G, B components
Values of pixels are accumulated as-is.

Values of pixels are used to see if the pixel fits 
one of the 12 bins

–Up: refers to sampling after decimation.
–L: luma (Y’) computed as R / 4 + G / 2 + B / 4 
when receiving RGB pixels, (R or G or B) 
when in raw Bayer mode.

–Down: refers to sampling after demosaicing 
(raw Bayer to RGB conversion), thus after 
both the exposure and white balance 
compensation, and when true RGB 
components (and thus luminance 
components) are available.

–0: AllPixels: no components are 
rejected
–1: NoExt16: components are 
rejected if < 16 or ≥ 240
–2: NoExt32: components are 
rejected if < 32 or ≥ 224
–3: NoExt64: components are 
rejected if < 64 or ≥ 192

Enables to reject extreme data, not 
accumulated for statistics.
Additional statistics (with MODE = Bin) are 
needed to count the amount of selected pixels. 
BINS = 0 is likely to be the most used setting.

–0: Low: Accu0 counts if V<4, 
Accu1 if V < 8, Accu2 if V<16
–1: LowMid: Accu0 counts if V < 32, 
Accu1 if V < 64, Accu2 if V < 128
–2: UpMid: Accu0 counts if V ≥ 128, 
Accu1 if V ≥ 192, Accu2 if V ≥ 224
–3: Up: Accu0 counts if V ≥ 240, 
Accu1 if V ≥ 248, Accu2 if V ≥ 252
Counts the amount of components V.

–1: Statistics extracted from 
sub-rectangle
–0: Statistics extracted from 
whole frame

Upper position of rectangle, from which 
statistics are extracted.

Left position of the rectangle, from which 
statistics are extracted.

Height of the sub-rectangle, from which 
statistics are extracted.

Width of the sub-rectangle, from which statistics 
are extracted.

Result of the 32-bit accumulation, re-sampled at 
frame boundary, and divided by 256 to fit the
